name: Banditry Reaches Tipping Point
description: The Banditry in %LOCATION_NAME has reached a tipping point. Bandits have overwhelmed the local garrison, and now run rampant and unopposed, bows and blades defeating halberds and steel armor by simple numeric advantage.

choices.name: Raid Food Stores
choices.description: The Bandits raid this location's food stores, negatively affecting the current food supply. Banditry is reduced by 100%.

choices.name: Rally the Bandits
choices.description:
The bandits rise up, creating a 50 man strong army, that will start razing locations at random. Banditry is reduced by 100%.

[Requires a non-capital location with 100% infiltration]

choices.name: Raid location
choices.description: Increases Devastation by 100. Banditry is Reduced by 100%.
